findings.message: The client sets `boxInitialized = typeof state.open?.box === "boolean"`. But clutch_app_ui_state get always merges the saved file over full defaults, and those defaults include `open.box: false`. So `open.box` is always a boolean and `boxInitialized` is always true. The existing auto-open in refresh (`sections.box.open = snap.boxCounts.pending > 0`) can then never run, even on a fresh install with no saved state. Scope in says to auto-open `box` whenever `open.box` was not saved. The harness hides this: its snapshot has pending=2, and it now asserts the box section is closed.
findings.paved_road: Let the client tell a saved open.box from the default. One way: the get reply also reports which `open` keys came from the file, such as a `saved` list or a flag for whether the file was read. Set `boxInitialized` only when `box` was actually saved. Add a harness case with no saved state and pending > 0 that asserts the Suggestion Box opens, plus one with saved `box: false` that asserts it stays closed.
